formCues: Extend rear leg back for balance
setup: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, torso tall and core braced.

formCues: Lean back as knees drive forward
setup: Stand holding a support, rise onto the balls of the feet with knees together.

setup: Step one foot forward into a staggered stance with the rear heel lifted.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or support for balance.

formCues: Stand tall on top of the box
Avoid pushing off the trailing leg

formCues: Step forward into a long stride

formCues: Drive knee high on each stride

formCues: Press through feet to lift hips

setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart at a marked starting line.

Not fully extending on the vertical phase

formCues: Drop into a squat then plank
Keep core tight in the plank

Lie on your back with knees bent out to the sides, soles of feet touching.

setup: Begin floating face down in the water in a streamlined position.

setup: Stand in a split stance facing away from the cable stack, handles at chest height.
